verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Tilled's merchant onboarding, payout-speed viewing, dispute management, and generic platform webhooks. Nothing documents per-sub-merchant fraud or credit-risk signals, alerts on anomalous sellers, or tools to pause payouts or offboard merchants. Generic event webhooks and dispute handling are adjacent features, not portfolio risk monitoring.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can watch risk across my seller portfolio — fraud and credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, alerts on anomalous sellers, and tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors
